body:
All 6 round-1 findings are verified fixed with real cargo; the probe is down to 0.22s and stderr is intact on the fresh path. Good work. Two small blocking items (round 3 is these only):
(A) Add --exclude to VAL_FLAGS. Different excludes currently share a stamp and compile unslotted.
(B) Date the stamp at the wrapper's t_start, not at finish. An edit made mid-run currently gets fresh-skipped.
Non-blocking: drop '2>/dev/null' from 'exec {ffd}>&- 2>/dev/null' at :575; add CARGO_INCREMENTAL/RUSTC_BOOTSTRAP to the env key; avoid pruning build/dist/.cache dirs inside workspace members; split out the cargo-log live_runs hunk. Order of merge once approved: #8 (needs the operator's hold clear), then #9, #10, #11.
subject: aida-host PR #9: round 2 CHANGES, narrow round 3 (two one-liners)
